cases.name: Maryanne C. Buss-Kincaid
cases.about:
Yeah. I mean, she hasn’t been out as much as she used to be, and she always kept her yard up really nicely,” (her neighbor) Michelle (declined to give last name) said. “She was very kind.”

Her obituary said: "Maryanne was a business owner for over 50 years. She was a dedicated mortuary beautician for decades at many funeral homes throughout Chicago's South Side. All the funeral homes Maryanne served remember her with gratitude and affection for the meticulous care she took to ensure loved ones looked their best. Maryanne was known to many for her larger-than-life personality. She was always the life of the party, a fashionista, a wine connoisseur, and took great pride in her career as a beautician. She had a heart of gold and would lend a helping hand to anyone in need. Maryanne enjoyed spending time outside in the summer, tending to her garden, and being in the sun. She absolutely cherished her occasional lunch trips with her girlfriends and adored her dogs, especially her pugs. She will be deeply missed by everyone who knew her."
cases.narrative: On 4/5/2026, a caretaker found her deceased from multiple gunshot wounds to the head.
